Subject: Acme MAP - mutual action plan recap & next steps

Hi Jared / Priya —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have aligned milestones and owners. If I missed anything, please flag edits inline.

Attendees (today):
- Jared Cole (Acme) — Dir. of Product
- Priya Sharma (Acme) — Head of AI
- Marissa Cole (Redwood) — Commercial AE
- Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood) — Solutions Engineer
- Neha Kapoor (Redwood) — Customer Success (shadowing)

Top pain points you shared:
- High token cost and unpredictable latency under peak load for in-product LLM features.
- Lack of observability into per-route cost and token breakdown (makes budgeting hard).
- Need options for private deployment for regulated datasets (esp. PII in support transcripts).

Goals we heard:
1) 30% reduction in per-token cost by switching to a combination of batching, prefix caching, and a quantized model profile within 90 days.
2) Consistent p95 latency < 350ms for 90% of requests during business hours.
3) Private deployment option for EU customer data by end of Q3 (compliance + KMS).

Decision process / stakeholders:
- Product (Jared) + AI/ML (Priya) lead technical evaluation and final tech sign-off.
- Procurement will own contract terms and budget (you mentioned procurement@acme.com).
- CTO-level commercial approval expected if pricing > $200k ARR.

Proposed MAP (milestones & tentative dates):
1) Workshop & integration scoping (Redwood SE + Acme engineers) — target week of Apr 4, 2027 — owner: Vivek / Priya
2) Test harness + baseline perf/cost run (3 weeks) — Apr 11–Apr 29 — owner: Acme devs with Redwood support
3) Production pilot (limited routes) — May 9–May 30 — owner: Product + CS
4) Pricing & contract finalization — target week of Jun 6 — owner: Procurement + Redwood Sales
5) Private deployment (if agreed) — target Q3 2027 implementation window — owner: Acme infra + Redwood private team

Open questions / blockers we noted:
- Which production routes you’d include in the pilot (ideally 2–3 high-volume, low-latency routes).
- Confirmation of procurement contact and preferred contracting cadence (SOW vs MSA + order form).
- Any specific SOC2 / audit evidence requirements beyond what we already shared.

Immediate next steps (formalizing):
- Vivek to schedule the technical workshop (I’ll send calendar invites for Apr 5–7 options).
- I’ll put together a MAP spreadsheet with milestone owners and deliverable checklist and share it after this note (attached).
- Vivek will send the test-harness template and minimal integration guide.

Attachments (sent with this thread):
- acme_map_milestones_20270328.xlsx (MAP template with proposed owners/dates)
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC2 summary & audit evidence index)

Thanks — appreciate the time today. If Apr 5–7 doesn't work for the workshop, suggest two alternate windows.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
